title: Podcast EP370: An Overview of PDF Solution’s New AI Platform and Upcoming CONNECT Event with Kimon W. Michaels - Semiwiki
gist: PDF Solutions' EVP Kimon Michaels describes Exensio Aurora, a third-generation platform with AI purpose-built for petabyte-scale semiconductor manufacturing data and secure agentic AI across operations and the supply chain. The company's CONNECT conference runs October 15-16 in San Francisco.

themes.theme: Exensio Aurora and agentic AI for fabs

insights.claim: PDF Solutions positions Exensio Aurora as its third-generation platform, with AI built for petabyte-scale semiconductor manufacturing data and secure agentic AI deployment across manufacturing operations and the supply chain.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Semiconductor data-analytics vendors are repositioning around agentic AI for yield; watch customer adoption and attach rates.
insights.locator: The recently announced Exensio Aurora capability

insights.claim: PDF's platform evolved from a worksheet-based first generation to a template-based second generation with scripting, then to the AI-centered third generation.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Shows a multi-decade product evolution from tooling to AI platform in yield analytics.

insights.claim: Aurora is meant to increase PDF's ability to analyze extensive product and manufacturing data to optimize yield and performance across the semiconductor supply chain.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Yield and performance optimization is the economic lever for fabs; a vendor claim without quantified results.

insights.claim: PDF Solutions is about to turn 35 years old, and Kimon Michaels, co-founder and EVP of Products and Solutions, leads the product evolution.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Long-tenured founder-led niche EDA analytics vendor.

insights.claim: PDF Solutions CONNECT, its yearly conference, will be held October 15 and 16 in San Francisco.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Near-term catalyst venue for product and customer announcements.
